rationale: The finding is valid and can be fixed within the spec. The spec requires two things. First, in 「2. 사람: 보고 확인」, the same `-Skip` is passed to the rerun. Second, in 「4. 부트스트랩」, the call shape that passes the branch and `-Skip` follows the form `pc-setup/bootstrap.ps1` defines. That form, from the header comment at lines 3-5, is: with no arguments use `irm ...main... | iex`, with arguments use `& ([scriptblock]::Create((irm ...<branch>...))) -Branch <branch> -Skip <Id>,<Id>`. pc-setup/test/verify-pc-checklist.md misses this in two places. (1) Line 84: the only command for `main` is the no-argument `iex` form, so there is no way to pass the `-Skip` the person chose in step 2 when the verification branch is main. Line 96 in step 5 reuses this command to rerun the bootstrap, so it has the same gap. (2) Line 109: the code block in step 6 has no `-Skip`, even though the body text says "같은 `-Skip` 유지". The `-Skip` variant in step 5 (line 101) is correct. bootstrap.ps1 already accepts `-Skip` for main through the argument form, so no new decision is needed.
instruction: Only edit pc-setup/test/verify-pc-checklist.md (Docs.Tests.ps1 does not need changes; do not weaken any existing assertion). (1) In step 4, rewrite the bootstrap command block so it splits by whether `-Skip` is given, not by branch. Keep the no-argument form (`irm .../main/pc-setup/bootstrap.ps1 | iex`) only for 'main branch and no `-Skip`'. For every other case (a different branch, or `-Skip` on main), show the argument form from the header comment of `pc-setup/bootstrap.ps1`: `& ([scriptblock]::Create((irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hdmun/anything/<branch>/pc-setup/bootstrap.ps1))) -Branch <branch> [-Skip <Id1>,<Id2>]`. On main, `<branch>` can be `main`. Give it as a command to copy, with the `& { ... } *>&1 | Tee-Object -FilePath "$env:TEMP\pc-setup-bootstrap.log"` wrapper kept as it is now. State that `-Skip` holds only what the person chose in step 2. (2) In the step 5 line that reruns the bootstrap with 'step 4's bootstrap command' (current line 96), say the same `-Skip` from step 2 is kept. (3) In the step 6 code block, add a `-Skip` variant in the same shape as step 5: `pwsh $HOME\anything\pc-setup\setup.ps1 -Skip <Id1>,<Id2> *>&1 | Tee-Object -FilePath "$env:TEMP\pc-setup-idempotent.log"`, under a `# -Skip 이 있을 때:` comment. Keep the `##` headings, their order and the `- [ ]`/"사람:" style. The gate command must pass.
